geocode.note: la/ln/lq joined on exact address string; lq=exact for Census Exact matches, approx for Non_Exact; No_Match/Tie/Not_Submitted rows carry null coordinates and stay listed in town mode.

county.source: US Census Geocoder geographies API @ town pin centroid; centres for unpinned/meeting-less towns from Census TIGERweb Places (Census 2020)
county.note: County is per town (the county its meeting pins centre on), baked into the page as CITY_COUNTY; EXTRA_CENTRES gives map centres for towns with no pinned meetings and for meeting-less towns like Grifton, so an empty town search can widen by miles. meetings.json is unchanged from v0.2.8.
